title: Diane Schuur Timeless CD Album Jazz Vocal Special Guest Soloist Stan Getz
descriptionText: The Diane Schuur Timeless CD Album is a jazz vocal collection featuring solo performances by renowned artist Stan Getz. Released under the record label Timeless, the album showcases Schuur's captivating vocal style with a multicolor design reflecting its timeless appeal. This special guest soloist edition is a must-have for jazz enthusiasts looking to experience the enchanting tunes of two legendary musicians.
